test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Average of 30 observations is 60 . Average of first 15 observations is 62 . Average of last 16 observations is 55 . What is the value of 15th observation?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ 15th observation = (Total Average) + (Sum of deviations from total average) Deviation of first 15 = 15 × (62 − 60) = +30 Deviation of last 16 = 16 × (55 − 60) = −80 15th observation = 60 + 30 − 80 = 10 **∴ The correct answer is 10.**
